year_display.zh: 约公元前 4 世纪成书

review.en: Attached to the terse Spring and Autumn Annals, the Zuo Zhuan turns 722 to 468 BCE into narrative: battles told through the decisions before them, envoys trading verses, ministers arguing in a few exact lines. Its authorship and date are uncertain. For two thousand years it was how educated Chinese learned their early history and how they learned to write narrative prose.
review.zh: 《左传》依附简略的《春秋》，把公元前 722 至前 468 年的历史写成叙事：写战争重在战前的抉择，写使臣赋诗应对，写大夫寥寥数语的争辩。作者与成书年代至今难定。两千年来，读书人靠它了解上古史，也从它学会怎样写叙事文。
